---
title: "Data downloads"
---

Every dataset used in these notes is available to download below. For background on
each one — where it came from and what the variables mean — see the [Datasets](appendix_data.qmd)
appendix.

The files live in the `teaching-data` repository, pinned to release `v2026.08.1`. Smaller
datasets download as plain CSVs, one file per link. The four largest come as a single zip
archive apiece; unzipping one produces a `data/` folder holding the files listed beside it.
One file inside the Survey of Consumers archive is gzipped (`.csv.gz`) because of its size;
`readr::read_csv()` and `pandas.read_csv()` both read gzipped CSVs directly, with no need
to unzip first.

## Austin houses

- [`austin_houses.zip`](https://github.com/jaredsmurray/teaching-data/releases/download/v2026.08.1/austin_houses.zip) — contains `austin_houses.csv` and `austin_houses_subset.csv` (plus cleaned versions of each)

- [`cps_asec_2023.csv`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jaredsmurray/teaching-data/v2026.08.1/data/mincer/cps_asec_2023.csv)
